experiment: G0 / experiment1: UniQuery4R teacher versus simulated object-point GT
download_scope: first four validation shards, containing 18 independent scenes; no full dataset download

selection.target_rule: largest t0 interior among instances with observed world translation >0.01 or observed rotation >0.05 rad; no future-based or teacher-based selection
selection.query_rule: deterministic farthest-point sampling on t0 instance interior, minimum 2 pixels; no repeated points

primary: 3D relative vector error normalized by t0 target 3D bbox diagonal
relative pair-length error on all 1128 point pairs
secondary: 3D absolute point error in GT first-camera frame
evaluation.scale: report raw plus one scene-global scale estimated only from t0 pair lengths, fixed for every time slot
evaluation.coordinate_frame: GT world to known first-camera frame; no future-dependent rotation, translation, or scale fit; absolute error includes camera-pose errors
evaluation.query_identity: fixed simulated material surface point from t0 object_coordinates and per-frame same-instance bboxes_3d
evaluation.visibility: separate visible and occluded using per-frame GT depth and instance mask; retain valid hidden 3D labels
evaluation.aggregation: per independent scene before scene-macro averages; all attempted scenes and exclusions retained
evaluation.model_training_overlap: must check UniQuery4R training provenance; this small set is teacher calibration, not an unseen-data generalization claim
